rows.meaning: give as part of a whole
rows.note: Use this for donating money, especially to a charity, church, or fund.

example.english: We contribute money to a charity fund.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 gam1

rows.meaning: give as part of a whole
rows.note: Use this when people pool money or each pay a share toward a larger expense or fund.

example.english: Everyone had to contribute money for this trip so we could afford to rent a car.
example.traditional: 今次旅行，大家一齊出錢，先夠錢租架車。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 ceot1 cin2 sin1 gau3 cin2 zou1 gaa3 ce1

rows.meaning: give as part of a whole
rows.note: Use this when the contribution is effort or practical help rather than money.

example.english: Everyone has to contribute to organizing this event.
example.traditional: 搞呢個活動，大家都要出力。
example.jyutping: gaau2 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 lik6

rows.meaning: give as part of a whole
rows.note: Use this formal term for contributing resources, ability, or effort to a cause or larger undertaking.

example.english: I hope to contribute my expertise to society.
example.traditional: 我希望用自己嘅專長，為社會作出貢獻。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 jung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 zyun1 coeng4 wai6 se5 wui6 zok3 ceot1 gung3 hin3
